query:
SELECT v.attendeeId, v.id as meetingId, v.timeSlot
FROM meetings v
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON v.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.companyName LIKE '%Veremark%' AND v.timeSlot IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6);
